The case: a public servant (employee at housing registration center) accepted a call, facilitated fraudulent issuance of property certificate using falsified documents, enabling mortgage and credit cards, leading to fraud. The employee neglected duty, didn't verify falsified documents. This is likely "徇私舞弊，不移交刑事案件" or "徇私舞弊" (abuse of power). But also could be "伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章" because he facilitated issuance of false property certificate? However the employee didn't forge documents himself; he accepted falsified documents and issued certificate without verification. The crime could be "徇私舞弊" (abuse of power, dereliction of duty) under criminal law article 397? Actually Chinese law: "徇私舞弊，不移交刑事案件" is a crime for public officials who, in performance of duties, conceal or fail to report criminal cases. Here he facilitated fraud, but not necessarily failing to report a criminal case. He may be guilty of "受贿"? No bribe. He may be guilty of "滥用职权" (abuse of power) because he used his authority to issue false certificate. The facts: He was asked to give '关照' (facilitate) and he did without verification. That is "滥用职权" (abuse of power) or "徇私舞弊". The prosecution says "其行为已构成××". The placeholder suggests they omitted the crime name. We need to infer.
